name: web-blue-and-lime-supplement-landing-with-numbered-signal-cards
title: Men's supplement page in royal blue, electric lime and white with condensed headlines, numbered cards and a giant testimonial
whatItIs: A very tall page with a ticker strip, hero 'OWN YOUR ENERGY.' with a blue keyword and a blue box beside a bottle, a white and blue split with a giant '02' and a formula panel, four numbered feature cards in blue, white, lime and white, a swimming-pool photo section with a big white statement, an ingredients photo and list, a dark ritual section, a white 'nothing to hide' section, a full lime testimonial band, a buy box, FAQ, a blue CTA band and a dark footer.
whatItMeans: Confident and clinical; blue, lime and white bands give a sports-lab feel.
techniques: Alternate full-width blue, lime, white and dark bands.
Use a big numeral as a graphic.
Give a full-width band to one testimonial.

vocabulary.definition: A full-width section in one colour.
A card with a big number and a benefit.
A section built around one large quote.
